Django News Application
  • API reference
  • news_application.settings

news_application.settings

Django settings for the news application.

Secrets and database connection details are read from environment variables (see .env.example) so no credentials are stored in the repository. If a .env file exists in the project root and python-dotenv is installed, its values are loaded first; variables already set in the environment take precedence.

Environment variables:

  • DJANGO_SECRET_KEY – secret key (default: a development-only value).

  • DJANGO_DEBUG – True or False (default True).

  • ALLOWED_HOSTS – comma-separated host names (default 127.0.0.1,localhost).

  • DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_HOST, DB_PORT – MySQL/MariaDB connection details.

  • APPROVED_API_URL – endpoint called after an article is approved.

Other notable settings:

  • AUTH_USER_MODEL is news.models.User.

  • The REST API uses token authentication and requires sign-in by default.

  • Emails are printed to the console (EMAIL_BACKEND is the console backend), which is suitable for local development.
